name: InterContinental San Francisco
positioning: Contemporary InterContinental hotel in San Francisco's SoMa district, next to the Moscone Convention Center
best_for: Travelers attending events at the Moscone Convention Center
Art lovers heading to SFMOMA and the Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco

facts.text: The hotel is next to the Moscone Convention Center and a short stroll from the city's financial, entertainment and shopping districts.
The hotel is a short walk from Yerba Buena Gardens, SFMOMA and Moscone Center.
Classic rooms blend calming tones, modern furnishings and warm wood details.
The suites provide expansive living areas, elevated privacy and exceptional views.
Bathrooms have marble-topped wooden vanities and glassed-in showers.
The lobby is a warm space with wood paneling and plenty of natural light.
The gym has Peloton bikes, treadmills, a StairMaster, free weights, a reformer and TRX suspension trainers.
Bar 888 specializes in grappa, with more than 100 varieties of the Italian grape-based brandy.
Bistro 888 serves seasonal California flavors from breakfast through dinner.
The hotel's sustainability program uses 100% renewable energy.
Pets are welcome at the hotel.

highlights.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with city or bay views.
The sixth floor has a heated indoor lap pool and a Jacuzzi.
The hotel is the preferred accommodations partner of the Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco.
Club InterContinental gives access to a private lounge with complimentary breakfast, evening drinks and canapes, and light refreshments through the day.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the SoMa neighborhood can be rough.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the hotel's luxury positioning.
